title: Calcutta High Court grants interim relief to TMC MP Mahua Moitra in hate speech case
description: The Calcutta High Court on Tuesday granted interim protection to Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Mahua Moitra against coercive police action in connection with a hate speech case.Justice Saugata Bhattacharya passed the order on a plea filed by Moitra to quash criminal proceedings tied to the hate speech case.
